facts.claim: The official attraction listing dates cathedral construction to 1892–1898 and highlights brick Gothic architecture.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: The construction of the cathedral started in 1892 and was completed in 1898. Unlike most Gothic buildings, Myeongdong Cathedral was built with bricks instead of stones.
